intention: Dashboard history charts show the day the data represents (EffectiveDate = CapturedAt - 1 day) formatted MM-DD in every tooltip, and carry a per-bar MM-DD date label (adaptive horizontal for 6-day / vertical for 14- and 30-day presets), fixing the 'yesterday shown as today' mismatch (Linear MAG-6).
request: Can you please create the openspec proposal for that ticket? MAG-6 (history graph change): tooltip date MM-DD; per-bar date label that fits in the 30-day view (vertical?); and the history graph should display the captured date - 1 day so the data makes sense. Use /grill-me to decide where the -1-day change lives.

decisions.decision: The 'captured_date - 1 day' adjustment lives on the telemetry Snapshot DTO as a new read-derived field (not in the gateway, not in a stored DB column). The offset is a property of the data's meaning; the owning module computes it once so all consumers stay consistent.
decisions.why: grill-me MAG-6 Q1: gateway-only compute is divergent for future consumers; a stored column is schema churn for a cheap read-time derivation. Confirmed by user.
decisions.covered_by: tier 1 design D2 / spec 'Snapshot Effective Date'

decisions.decision: The new field is named EffectiveDate time.Time.
decisions.why: grill-me MAG-6 Q2: cleanly separates 'when we read it' (CapturedAt) from 'which day it describes' (EffectiveDate); does not lock the name to the history-graph use case. SummaryDate/CoverageDate/ReportedDate rejected. Confirmed by user.
decisions.covered_by: tier 1 design D1 / Snapshot struct field

decisions.decision: The backend field is a full time.Time (same shape as CapturedAt, including the year, preserving time-of-day); MM-DD formatting is a cosmetic/UI concern owned by the gateway, NOT baked into the telemetry field.
decisions.why: grill-me MAG-6 Q3: keeps the field reusable for any future caller/format. Confirmed by user.
decisions.covered_by: tier 1 design D3 / tier 2 design D1

decisions.decision: Both the tooltip and the per-bar label use EffectiveDate formatted MM-DD. Showing the label from EffectiveDate and the tooltip from CapturedAt would re-introduce the 1-day mismatch MAG-6 fixes.
decisions.why: Consistency between label and tooltip; the ticket fix only holds if both use the represented day.

decisions.decision: Per-bar label orientation is adaptive: horizontal MM-DD for the 6-day preset (wide bars), rotated vertical MM-DD for the 14- and 30-day presets (narrow bars). The handler decides orientation from the preset and exposes a single chart-level LabelVertical bool; the template reads only the flag.
decisions.why: grill-me MAG-6 Q-labels: the ticket hints at vertical labels; adaptive gives readability at every preset. Template stays logic-free (no days comparison / rotation math). Confirmed by user.
decisions.covered_by: tier 2 design D2/D3/D4 / spec 'Label orientation is adaptive'

decisions.decision: EffectiveDate is computed with CapturedAt.AddDate(0,0,-1) (calendar-day arithmetic), not Add(-24h) (duration), so DST does not shift the represented day.
decisions.why: Nightly cadence is a calendar-day cadence; DST 23/25-hour days would offset a duration by an hour.
decisions.covered_by: tier 1 design D4 / spec DST scenario
